elements.justification: 'motorcycle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle ('every motor vehicle equipped with a seat or saddle for the use of the driver and designed to travel on not more than three wheels in contact with the ground, excluding an electric bicycle, a tractor or a moped'), one atom, never replaced by ru.motorcycle.

No definition applies to 'motor scooter'. A seated motor-driven scooter is either a motor vehicle on not more than three wheels with a seat, already a member of the motorcycle aggregate of s1, or a small-engined scooter that DEF-NRS-484A-125 names as a 'motor-driven scooter', which the motorcycle definition excludes as a moped: ru.moped, 'a low-power two- or three-wheeler with a small engine or motor, as a jurisdiction classes it'. The standing electric scooter (ru.electric_scooter) is not a 'motor scooter' of this chapter: the code defines and regulates 'electric scooter' separately (DEF-LVMC-11-02-083, chapter 11.40).

'be ridden' is the machine in controlled motion: not drv.motion.complete_halt ('The road user is at rest at the observation — complete cessation from movement', speed at or below a tolerance). A motorcycle at rest on a sidewalk is not ridden. Who rides is read through the machine's motion (observable_reading, agency).

'sidewalk' (DEF-NRS-484A-240: 'that portion of a highway between the curb lines or the lateral lines of a highway and the adjacent property lines intended for the use of pedestrians') is st.sidewalk, 'area for pedestrians between roadway and property line'; not a crosswalk, its exclusion. 'upon any' is the footprint overlapping it: rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... sidewalk ...)').

assumptions.meaning: the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area

applicability: The subject is a motorcycle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle) or a moped (ru.moped) whose footprint overlaps a sidewalk (rel.occupies, st.sidewalk) at a place the reading declares within the city's limits (asm.within_city_limits), read at the judged observation.
obligation: At every such observation the subject is at rest (drv.motion.complete_halt with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance); moving while on the sidewalk is violated.

narrowings.why: 'be ridden' is read through the machine's controlled motion (not at rest); whether a person sits on it or pushes it is not told apart.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle (ru.motorcycle) moves at 3 m/s with its footprint on a st.sidewalk, at a place declared asm.within_city_limits true.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle stands at rest (kin.speed at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance) on a sidewalk within the city.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle moves on the roadway and occupies no sidewalk.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle is on a sidewalk within the city; the source does not observe kin.speed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A moped (ru.moped) moves at 2 m/s on a sidewalk within the city.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle moves on a sidewalk at a place declared asm.within_city_limits false.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed quantisation of the acquisition standard's scene graph
